title: Scheduled outages in the contact plan: storage at rover, relay and Earth

criteria.text: Every rover envelope handed to ION is received at Earth
Every Earth command handed to ION is received at the rover
Every received envelope is byte-identical to the envelope handed to ION
criteria.measured: 127 of 127 received envelopes byte-identical (SHA-256 and header)

criteria.text: Every received envelope is accepted (no TTL expired in storage)
At 45 s the rover node holds rover envelopes sent since the rover-Gateway outage began
criteria.measured: rover node held 20 matching bundles at 45.000 s (all bundles: 21)

criteria.text: At 45.5 s the Gateway node holds Earth commands waiting for the rover contact
criteria.measured: gateway node held 3 matching bundles at 45.500 s (all bundles: 3)

criteria.text: At 80 s the Gateway node holds rover envelopes sent since 63 s, waiting for the Earth contact
criteria.measured: gateway node held 18 matching bundles at 80.000 s (all bundles: 18)

criteria.text: At 80.5 s the Earth node holds commands waiting for the Gateway contact
criteria.measured: earth node held 2 matching bundles at 80.500 s (all bundles: 3)

criteria.text: Rover envelopes sent during the rover-Gateway outage arrive no earlier than its end (50 s) plus 1.55 s propagation
Earth commands sent during the rover-Gateway outage arrive no earlier than its end plus 0.25 s
Rover envelopes sent during the Gateway-Earth outage arrive no earlier than its end (85 s) plus 1.3 s
Earth commands sent during the Gateway-Earth outage arrive no earlier than its end plus 1.55 s
No duplicate or unknown envelope is received
criteria.measured: 127 recv records, 0 without a matching send record

criteria.text: No receiver accepts an envelope older than its TTL
criteria.measured: 108 accepted envelopes with TTL > 0; 0 older than their TTL

criteria.text: No node transmits into a scheduled outage (emulator blackout drops = 0)
LTP segments from the Gateway discarded by Earth's LTP screening (informative)
criteria.measured: earth node, span to gateway: in_seg_screened = 0 (ltpstats -a)

criteria.text: LTP segments from the rover discarded by the Gateway's LTP screening (informative)
criteria.measured: gateway node, span to rover: in_seg_screened = 0 (ltpstats -a)

criteria.text: Checkpoints the Gateway resent to Earth (informative)
criteria.measured: gateway node, span to earth: ckpt_re_xmit = 0 (ltpstats -a)
